offers_products.reason: Cloud SaaS network: EDI, Fulfillment, Assortment, Analytics, Revenue Recovery software sold on subscription.

offers_services.reason: Full-service EDI, vendor onboarding, testing and certification, and managed partner community services are core offerings alongside the platform.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are retailers, suppliers, brands, distributors and logistics providers; no individual or household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to retailers, grocers, brands, manufacturers, distributors and logistics providers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscription network platform used continuously for orders, invoices and item data; customers stay connected long term.

cyclical_demand.reason: EDI connectivity is mandated by retail trading partners and embedded in daily operations; hard to cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Subscription fees are small and recurring, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from the software network and data platform, not staff time, despite onboarding services.

large_customers.reason: Many suppliers are small and mid-sized brands, though top retailers are also customers; mix leans toward SMB suppliers.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software and network business needing little physical plant or fleet investment.

notes: Customer size is mixed: large retailers and many small suppliers.
